mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_QUOTE WHERE STATUS = #{status}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, R.MOVE_DATE, Q.FROM_ADDRESS, Q.TO_ADDRESS, R.STATUS FROM TBL_RESERVATION R JOIN TBL_MOVE_REQUEST Q ON Q.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID JOIN TBL_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = Q.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY R.APPLIED_AT DESC, R.RESERVATION_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
